Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. India wrapped things up in time and they will be pleased that they avenged the loss at the same venue in 2015. Sri Lanka go back to the drawing board for the umpteenth time in the last few years. They need to raise the bar to stay afloat in the series. We look forward to your company for the 2nd Test starting on August 3, 2017 at the Sinhalese Sports Club Ground, Colombo. Action begins at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

India skipper, Virat Kohli says that the loss in 2015 hurt them but this time they came back stronger to start off on a positive note. Reckons that the surface did not offer much to the bowlers and hence the win is more pleasing. Credits his bowlers for the skills they possess and their contributions. Mentions that the selection dilemma for the opening slots is a massive headache but it's always nice to have such competition in the squad. Adds that everyone of them is performing which makes it even better. Credits Abhinav Mukund for the way he batted and feels that the southpaw deserved a ton. Ends by saying that he was just looking to capitalize on the situation when he started batting in the second innings.

Sri Lanka skipper, Rangana Herath says that he is feeling better and hopes to be fit soon. Does not think that the toss was that crucial. Credits India for outplaying them in all the three departments of the game. Rues the injury to Asela Gunaratne since he is a key player for them. Hopes that they manage to raise their game ahead.

Man of the Match, Shikhar Dhawan says that he really enjoyed batting out in the middle. Reckons that he was positive throughout and was looking to score runs. Adds that the competition in the side helps him bring out the best and also keeps him on the toes to keep performing.

This is India's biggest win away from home, fourth highest overall. They are not a great Test side yet but they do their basics right and it works against teams who are not that strong. They made a lot of mistakes, dropped catches, had poor bowling plans yet came out on top thanks to the gulf in the quality of the teams.

Chasing history, the Islanders had come out victors in their previous Test against Zimbabwe but come India, they were found wanting. Their approach was hard to understand, they played their shots and kept losing wickets regularly. Dimuth Karunaratne was the only one to put up a fight and not surprising that he didn't play any extravagant shot - till he got out. It is not how you play Test cricket, no matter whatever your natural game is. All the talented batsmen in Kusal Mendis, Upul Tharanga, Angelo Mathews got starts but failed to kick on. Their bowling without Rangana Herath is like a fish out of pond. They have lots to ponder upon. The fitness of their stand-in skipper will be a concern for them.

India set up the game thanks to their massive first innings total. Both Shikhar Dhawan and Cheteshwar Pujara notched up tons as India posted a mammoth total on the board. Nuwan Pradeep was the pick of the bowlers for the hosts registering his best figures in Test cricket. Ravindra Jadeja then led the Indian attack and helped the visitors take a 309-run lead. They, however, chose not to enforce the follow-on. After a failure in the first innings, Virat Kohli notched up a ton in the second innings to set a target of 550 for the hosts.

No Rangana Herath, no Asela Gunaratne and Sri Lanka have lost this Test inside four days. Doesn't it reflect perfectly on the two individuals? Those two have done most of the hard work in the last few series and without their brilliance, it has resulted in India winning for the first time in Galle since 2008.

I just blurted out that he would have been unlucky if he missed out on a ton and now he gets out trying to sweep one off his stumps. A pretty long, lonely walk to the pavilion for him. A meandering session of Test cricket. India started off on a positive note where Jadeja took two quick wickets. But since then Karunaratne and Dickwella have looked settled in the middle with the former inching towards his ton. The Indian bowlers are toiling really hard but except a couple of dropped catches, they haven't been able to create anything special. The visitors will want these two batsmen to see this day off for them if they wish to have a chance to stay in the game. An exciting final session of cricket awaits us.

OUT! What a poor, poor, poor, poor shot! Jadeja floats it around off, Angelo Mathews thinks they are chasing 500 in 20 overs for some reason. He comes down to go big down the ground, the ball goes off the leading edge and Hardik Pandya takes the catch coming forward from backward point. That is a poor choice of shot. You can be as positive as you want to but cannot be reckless like that. You are the most senior batsman at the moment, and if that is how you are going to bat, it does not inspire much confidence to a nation struggling to compete in this format of the game.

Fuller on middle, turned through mid on for a single.
Floats it around off, Karunaratne comes forward and defends it.
Mathews gets off the mark with a square drive through point.
Short which is punched to short cover. The fielder fails to stop cleanly and parries it towards mid off. No run taken though.
Drives it towards mid off from his crease.
Loops it around off, Mathews comes forward and drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Top shot! Bowls it around off, Karunaratne kneels down and clubs it in front of square for a boundary.
Another forward defense from Karunaratne.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it around middle, Karunaratne comes forward and blocks it.
Lands it around off, Dimuth comes forward and defends it.
Floats it around off, driven to covers by Dimuth.
Fuller outside off, driven to covers by Mathews.
Angelo Mathews comes out to bat with the team in trouble.

OUT! India review successfully! Jadeja fires it outside off, the ball skids on, Mendis goes back to punch but seems to have edged it. The keeper collects the ball and appeals hard. The players are convinced and ask Kohli to go for the review. The Indian skipper obliges. Ultra Edge detects a spike as the ball goes past the bat and hence the onfield call has to be turned over. Kusal Mendis has to walk back to the hut after playing a good knock.
Shorter around off, Kusal goes back and punches it into the off side.
Plays it into the off side from his crease.
Shorter around middle, Mendis sits low and pulls it down towards short fine leg off his body.
Floats it around off, Mendis comes forward and defends it.
Goes round the wicket and bowls it on off, Karunaratne keeps it out.
Shorter around off, punched to covers.
Dimuth gets in line and defends it.
Tossed around off, spins away, Karunaratne is beaten on his push.
Lands it around leg, Dimuth shapes to sweep but is hit on his pads. An appeal for an lbw is turned down. Pitched outside leg? Maybe.
Tossed up around off, Karunaratne comes forward and drives it to covers.
A tad slow around off, Karunaratne comes down and nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around off, Dimuth comes forward and defends it.
This one is clipped to short leg by the batsman.
Darts it on the pads, Karunaratne fails to clip and it goes off the pads towards the leg side.
Fired around off, Mendis camps back and dabs it towards third man. Three runs taken.
Flatter outside off, left alone.
Goes back and defends it.
Floats it around off, Mendis clips it off the inner half towards the leg side. Kohli has a shy at the striker's end. Mendis does not like that. A single taken.
Flatter down the leg side, Mendis tucks it towards the leg side.
Wide down leg, left alone.
Mendis comes forward and turns it towards mid on from his crease.

NOT OUT! Poor review! Shorter down the leg side, Mendis looks to clip but seems to have missed it. Saha collects and appeals long and hard. Nothing from the umpire. Kohli goes for the review on the word of Saha. Replays detect nothing and that is a review wasted by India.
Saha is confident that he has Mendis caught behind. The umpire does not think it is out and hence India review.
Flatter around off, Dimuth stays in his crease and defends it.
Floats it outside off, Karunaratne comes forward and defends it.
Drops it short again, punched wide of covers for a couple of runs.
Shorter around off, punched towards wide mid off from his crease.
Floats it outside off, Kusal Mendis drives it on the up through covers. Shami gives it a chase and keeps the ball in play. Three runs taken.
FOUR! Smacked! Jadeja bowls it around off, Mendis kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
12th Test fifty for Dimuth Karunaratne!
Fuller on middle and leg, Karunaratne drives it past the diving bowler. Pandya gets across from long off and cuts it off. Two runs taken and it brings up Dimuth's fifty. He has played well so far.
Karunaratne comes forward to defend but gets it off the outer half, short of the gully fielder.
Flighted around off, shorter again, Dimuth carefully punches it towards point.
FOUR! Put away! Shorter and outside off, Karunaratne goes back and cuts it to the sweeper cover fence for a boundary. Poor ball and punished!
A mid-wicket in place now.
Lands it around off, Karunaratne defends it coming forward.
Loops it around off, spins away, watchfully left alone.
Fired on the pads, Kusal fails to tick it. The ball runs down to fine leg and the batsmen take a couple of leg byes as the ball went off the pads reckons the umpire.
Bowls the arm ball outside off, wide enough for Mendis to let it go.
Floats it outside off, spins away, no shot offered.
Shorter outside off, punched to covers by the batsman.
Loops it outside off, left alone by Mendis.
Floats it around off, pushed towards mid off from his crease.
Ravindra Jadeja will bowl from the other end.
Loops it around off, Karunaratne comes forward and pushes it towards the off side.
Shorter on middle, Mendis goes back and tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
Loops it outside off, Mendis comes down and drives it towards mid off.
Short and around off, Mendis goes back and punches it towards covers.
Mendis comes down and turns it towards short mid-wicket.
Floats it around middle, Mendis comes forward to defend but gets it off the outer half towards the off side.
Virat Kohli has his team in a huddle. India will want to keep taking wickets. They haven't bowled that well, both the batsmen have often got the boundary balls too easily.
The players are out in the middle for play. Dimuth Karunaratne and Kusal Mendis come out to bat. India begin the session with Ravichandran Ashwin. A slip in place for him. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

That's a fighting session of Test cricket. India declared after a bash and then nipped out Upul Tharanga and Danushka Gunathilaka early in the piece. The pair of Kusal Mendis and Dimuth Karunaratne has done well to keep the visitors at bay. The Indian spinners haven't quite bowled as well as they would have liked. They need 8 more wickets to win. The hosts still need 465 runs to win, it is a long way away for now. Join us in a while for the second session.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Karunaratne clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Flatter outside off, Karunaratne lets it through to the keeper.
Outside off, Dimuth stays deep and cuts it towards the fielder at backward point.
Floated outside off, Mendis drives it towards mid off and calls for a quick single. Karunaratne responds well there.
Gully in place now.
Short outside off, punched towards extra cover for a single.
Tossed up around leg, Karunaratne defends it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Karunaratne whips it through the mid-wicket region. Umesh Yadav gives it a chase, dives to stop the ball and saves a run for his team.
Mendis stays deep in his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, clipped towards the fielder at short leg.
A bit short in line of the stumps, Mendis camps back and defends it well.
Similar delivery and an identical result.
Tossed up around off, Mendis lunges forward and defends it.
Floated outside off, Dimuth prods forward in defence.
Flatter around off, Karunaratne stays back and defends it. That kept a tad low.
50-run stand between Karunaratne and Mendis!
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Short around leg, Mendis flicks it towards the mid-wicket region.
Shortish outside off, Kusal camps back and punches it towards wide mid on.
Floated around middle, Mendis lunges forward to defend.
A bit flatter, the batsman camps back and defends it.
Full in line of the stumps, Karunaratne digs it out towards the fielder at short cover.
Dimuth lunges forward and defends it on the off side.
Floated outside off, Karunaratne defends it towards point.
Floated outside off, clipped through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short around leg, Mendis helps it towards the fielder at leg gully.
Lands it around middle, Karunaratne defends it on the leg side.
Around leg, Dimuth flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Floated around off, Karunaratne comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Karunaratne gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Edged! Tossed up around middle and off, Mendis gets forward to defend. Is beaten by the turn as he edges it just short of the slip fielder. The ball goes towards short third man for a single.
Flatter outside off, Mendis camps back and defends it.
Around leg, Karunaratne stays in his crease and defends it on the leg side.
Dimuth gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it on the off side.
Shorter around off, Karunaratne punches it to covers.
Tossed up around middle and off, Dimuth defends it on the leg side.
Fuller in line of the stumps, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Mendis flicks it through the square leg region for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Again short into the pads, Mendis flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
A bit short down the leg side, Karunaratne clips it through square leg for a single.
Karunaratne camps back and defends it towards short leg.
Around middle and off, Mendis gets forward in defence. Gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg for a single.
Floated outside off, Mendis punches but on the bounce to the fielder at silly point. Lucky to not get hit on the jaw.
Sharp turn! Floated outside off, turns off the surface. Karunaratne comes forward to defend but is beaten by the away spin.
Floated around off, Dimuth gets forward to defend.
Tossed up outside off, Mendis drives it towards long on for a single.
Fuller around middle and leg, Karunaratne drives it through the cover-point region for a single.
Again outside off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller outside off, driven towards covers.
Ravichandran Ashwin is called in for a bowl.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Mendis lunges forward and defends it well.
Tossed up around off, Mendis gets cramped a bit but still manages to defend it off the back foot.
Fuller in line of the stumps, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Spinning in from around off, Karunaratne defends it neatly.
Quicker into the pads, Karunaratne works it through the square leg region for a couple.
Shorter around leg, Dimuth stays in his crease and nudges it through square leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Karunaratne gets forward to defend it on the off side.
Angling into the hips from a good length, Karunaratne takes his bat out of the way and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Karunaratne defends it on the leg side.
Good length delivery around off, Dimuth stays deep and defends it off the outer half towards the fielder at point.
Fuller outside off, Karunaratne lunges forward and drives it through the extra cover region for a couple.
Tossed up around off, Mendis gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it well.
Floated outside off, Mendis shoulders his arms to it.
FOUR! Good shot! Shorter outside off, Mendis camps back and cuts it through the backward point region for a boundary.
Karunaratne clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Fuller around middle and off, Karunaratne does not let Jadeja settle and goes for the reverse sweep. Times it well and gets it through the point region for a boundary.
Ravindra Jadeja is called into the attack.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, nipping away. Mendis tries to poke at it but is completely foxed by the away movement.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Good length delivery around off, Mendis flicks it towards the fielder at mid on.
On a shorter length down the leg side, Karunaratne shuffles across and nudges it through the square leg region. Shami cuts it off in the deep from fine leg to save a run for his team.
Angling into the pads, Karunaratne fails to clip it on the leg side. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire is not interested as it was probably pitching outside leg.
Jadeja is warming up!
Sprayed way wide outside off, Karunaratne is never going to play at it.
Short delivery outside off, Mendis sways away from the line of the ball.
Fuller into the pads, Karunaratne looks to clip but maybe it hits him on his pads. The ball goes towards short fine leg and the umpire signals it as a run.
Length delivery again around off, Karunaratne defends it neatly.
Back of a length delivery outside off, pushed through the cover region for a single.
Another length delivery outside off, Mendis lunges forward and defends this time towards the fielder at mid off.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Mendis prods forward and defends it.
Shorter outside off, cut through the point region for a single to keep strike.
Back of a length delivery around off, Mendis shoulders his arms to it.
Good length delivery around off, Mendis stays behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Outside off, left alone.

Edged but safe! Length delivery outside off, Mendis tries to drive. Is beaten by the away movement as he ends up edging it. The ball goes towards second slip. Virat Kohli dives to his right to stop the ball on a bounce.
Angling into the hips, clipped through the mid-wicket region for a couple.

Time for Drinks! Sri Lanka have lost a couple of quick wickets which has made their life even more difficult. The Indian pacers will look to make further inroads as they look to decimate the opposition totally.
Length delivery around off, Dimuth gets forward and blocks it away.
FOUR! Edged! Good length delivery outside off, Karunaratne has a push at it. Edges it through the backward point region for a boundary.
A slip moves out and a short cover is in place.
Length delivery outside off, Karunaratne stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
Back of a length delivery around off. Mendis shuffles across and defends it towards wide mid on for a single.
Shami is hitting the straps now. Bowls again on a probing length outside off, Kusal chooses to let it through this time. A bit inside the line could be trouble for the batsman.
Length delivery around off, nipping away after pitching. Mendis lets it through this time.
Back of a length delivery around off, Dimuth defends it off the back foot.
Fuller delivery way outside off, Karunaratne goes fetching for it. Plays the drive but he fails to make contact.
Some sightscreen issues again. Karunaratne gets it solved.
Short into the hips, KM clips it through the backward square leg region for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! Fuller delivery outside off, Mendis leans forward and plays a crispy front foot drive through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Fuller delivery around off, Kusal drives it back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kusal Mendis raises his bat skywards.
Around the stumps, Karunaratne flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Mohammed Shami stops in his run up. There is an extra ball on the ground. The ball-boy picks it up and departs.

FOUR! Very well bowled but countered brilliantly! Fuller delivery right in line of the stumps, Karunaratne transfers his weight back a bit and clips it elegantly through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Length delivery around off, the ball stays low a bit. Dimuth tries to push at it but gets beaten.
Dug in short this time, Karunaratne ducks under it.
Back of a length delivery angling into the hips, Dimuth shuffles a bit and clips it towards fine leg for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Karunaratne gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Back of a length around middle, nudged towards backward square leg for a single.
Full and on the pads, Mendis gets off the mark with a flick to deep backward square leg. Kusal gets off the pair.
Kusal Mendis walks out to the middle.

OUT! Two soft dismissals for Gunathilaka! He threw his bat at a wide one in the first innings and now has picked out the fielder on the other side. Not good. Coming to the ball, it was a full length delivery around middle, Gunathilaka shaped to clip it but the bat turned in his hands. Pujara completed the simplest of catches at mid-wicket and that is it for Danushka. He was picked thanks to his ODI form but he needs to be a lot more circumspect in the whites. Sri Lanka two down already!
Back of a length outside off, punched towards the point region.
Good length around off, Gunathilaka defends it towards the off side.
Almost! Full and outside off, Gunathilaka comes forward to drive but the bat turns in his hands and it lobs towards mid off. That was well bowled by Umesh.
Stays back in his crease and turns one towards the leg side.
Good length around off, Dimuth defends it from his crease.
Fuller around off, Gunathilaka turns it to the left of Jadeja at mid on and takes a quick single.
The field is up on the off side, Shami bowls it on the pads, Karunaratne tucks it towards short fine leg for a single. That would not have been good viewing for the captain.
Three slips in place now. No third man. No deep square leg.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length around off, Gunathilaka defends it.
Good length outside off, Karunaratne stays back and defends it.
Gets in line and defends it.
FOUR! Classical! Fuller around off, Karunaratne comes forward and drives it down the ground, just past the umpire and through long off for a boundary. Superb shot!
Full toss outside off, Dimuth looks to drive but the bat turns in his hand and he mistimes it to covers.
Pitched up around off, Karunaratne comes forward and defends it.
Slants it across on a length, left alone by Karunaratne.
Full and outside off, left alone by Gunathilaka.

OUT! The dropped catch has not cost India anything! Shami angles it on a back of a length, Tharanga is cramped for room as he aims to play at it with an angled bat. The ball goes off the inside edge and cannons onto the stumps. Virat Kohli will be a relieved man. India get the breakthrough early. Think a lot of batsmen today get out trying to play a shot than trying to defend. Tells you about the positive mindset but also about players not backing their defenses. Danushka Gunathilaka is the new man in.
Tharanga stays in his crease and defends it.

DROPPED! Good length outside off, Tharanga pokes at it. The ball goes off the outside edge straight to Virat Kohli at second slip. He drops it, can't believe that himself and that is a chance gone down. Not new though, we have seen him dropping catches in the slips.
Good length around middle, Tharanga turns it towards mid-wicket.
Shami goes round the wicket.
FOUR! Deft! Short and outside off, Tharanga plays it with an angled bat wide of the gully fielder for a boundary. Poor bowling with the new ball.
Shami has an issue with the ball.
Back of a length outside off, left alone by Dimuth.
FOUR! Tucked! Shorter and on the pads, Karunaratne clips it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Sri Lanka are chasing this?
Swap of the fielders. The one who failed to stop it at mid-wicket is now standing on the off side.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Drifts it on the pads this time, tucked through the diving mid-wicket fielder for a couple of runs. Wayward start for the Indian pacers again.
Slings it outside off, fuller length, Karunaratne plays inside the line of the ball and the ball goes past the bat.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off by the batsman.
Umesh Yadav to steam in from the other end.
Edged! Good length around off, Tharanga shapes to defend but gets an edge past the gully fielder. Third slip fielder hares after it and stops it. Two runs taken. Nice start for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Nicely played! Back of a length outside off, Tharanga just punches it off his crease. More of a push and the ball runs to the deep point fence.
Once again, Upul shapes to turn one through the leg side but gets hit on his body.
FIVE WIDES! Short ball around middle, Tharanga ducks under it. Saha cannot stop it and the ball runs down to the fence for a boundary. Wides signaled.
Good length around middle, Tharanga keeps it out towards the leg side.
Shorter in length around off, Tharanga shapes to defend but gets an inside edge onto his body.
ALMOST! Short ball from Shami, climbing on the batsman, Karunaratne looks to fend it away. The ball flies off the splice of the bat and goes wide of gully for a single to third man.
